sprint.title: Immediate Local Travel Phrase Alignment
sprint.goal: Align go to <location> and head to <location> with existing immediate local movement, without converting nonlocal destination identification into travel.
acceptance_criteria: go to <location> and head to <location> move only for a uniquely named immediately traversable current-scene connection, with the same destination and movement behavior as the corresponding directional and move to forms.
Non-adjacent names retain existing nonmoving destination-identification behavior and do not invoke travel, pathfinding, or multi-step routing.
Ambiguous or invalid immediate names fail closed without player movement, history, or other state change.
The interaction kernel resolves only immediate scene candidates; the destination resolver remains the fallback for nonmoving loaded-region identification when no immediate unique match exists.
No persistence, history model, parser framework, provider behavior, migration, or save-version change is introduced.

staging_commands: Official-interpreter preflight through the established workspace procedure
focused_commands: Focused immediate local travel phrase-alignment tests
Affected interaction-kernel, movement, navigation-projection, save/load, narration-context, and provider-safe regressions

governance: This owner-authorized capability package is active; no following sprint is authorized or staged.
Simulation retains authority over structural connectivity and movement; immediate travel phrases may resolve only against current-scene traversable connections.
The interaction kernel owns immediate candidate resolution; the destination resolver remains the nonmoving loaded-region identification fallback.
Do not infer or execute nonlocal destination relationships, travel, destination knowledge, or multi-step routing. Save version remains 1.
Provider requests are forbidden for automated verification, and next_sprint remains null.
